permitId.description: Historical bootstrap permit at issuance, not the ID required after successful consumption and renewal.

factObservationId.description: Historical issuance observation. Current same-identity observations may replace it for ongoing output, never to regrant START.

expiresAt.description: Exclusive first-consumption deadline; not the deadline of an already consumed active execution. Immutable.

ReceiverConsumeTicket.description: 256-bit opaque capability, ONLY first START/continuation response. Example fixtures only; never log production tickets or persist plaintext.
